one_line: An honest parent admission, then each expert tip acted out on the real baby with the book in hand.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static wide shot: a mom on a floor sofa, a baby and a yellow board book on her lap, a friend laughing. Voice from 0:00 (transcript): "לא כזה הקפדתי להקריא לסיפורים". Subtitles from 0:01, no headline.
q1_hook.why: A parent admitting a gap she has not fixed is a "not alone" moment (K6), with a laughing friend promising warmth (K1). Voice and faces from the first second (H4), the book in hand (S1). But no headline text before 0:01 (T3) and the first cut only at 0:05 (E1).

beats.what: Static wide: mom, baby, book, laughing friend; the admission about reading aloud
beats.why: The honest confession sets up a problem to be fixed.

beats.what: Close-up: mom holds the book up to the baby, the friend leans in; "לתת לי דגשים ומשמעות"
beats.why: Introduces the expert as the fix.

beats.what: Wide: the expert positions the baby; "אותי וגם את הספר", "הוא הקשר בינינו"
beats.why: Tip one is shown with hands, not only said.

beats.what: Close-up: mom reads with a wide-open mouth; "חשוב גם לשלב רגש"; pink smiley at 0:17
beats.why: A funny face is the Reel's one comic beat.

beats.what: Close-up, book on the baby's lap, fingers on the page; "שורה אחת או שתיים לכל עמוד"
beats.why: Tip two on one angle for 12 s; the slow stretch.

beats.what: Handheld close-up of the baby; "נאריך את המלל לכל דף עם הגיל", let the baby touch the book
beats.why: Tips three and four share one angle.

beats.what: Mom turns the book to the baby, gesturing; "ספר טוב הוא הרבה יותר מסיפור"
beats.why: Moves from tips to the feeling, a warmer lift.

beats.what: Wide: both women and the baby, mom delighted; "ועוזר לשפה להתפתח"; fade to dark
beats.why: Returns to the opening framing and ends warm.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None in the video. Caption: "זמינות פה לכל שאלה" invites questions to the tagged speech therapist, not a comment ask. The four tips are saveable but not framed as a save.
q2_flow.why: The admission opens a small arc and the closing line ("what the baby needs now") returns to it (K2, R4). Angle changes every 4 to 12 s keep it from a static talking head (E2), but 0:18 to 0:39 is two long single-angle stretches of plain tips (R3). Tips worth sending to a new parent (R5).

q3_cta.what: None in the video: no spoken or written ask, the last frames fade out. Caption: thanks to the speech therapist, "זמינות פה לכל שאלה" and her tag @hilla_gover_slp.
q3_cta.why: One purposeful ask, questions to the expert, so no bait (C1, C2). But it sits only in the caption, is not said or shown after the tips (C6), and sends viewers to the expert, not to a book or a next step. A buyer would have nothing to do.

q4_shown.what: An unbranded colourful board book with a yellow spine, in hand from 0:00, held up to the baby, pointed at, touched by the baby. A baby about 5 to 6 months, a mom and a speech therapist on camera. No price, review or result.
q4_shown.why: Each tip is acted out on the real baby with the book, so the viewer sees it (S1, K4). A visible expert carries modest claims (S6). The book is unnamed, so it works as a tip, not a product pitch (C7, H3). The baby's face is on screen, which LumeBook's own Reels should avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: 8 shots in 51.7 s, 6.5 s average, straight cuts alternating wide and close (0:05, 0:09, 0:16, 0:18, 0:30, 0:39, 0:46). No speed change seen. Subtitles change about every second with the voice. Fade to dark after the last line.
q5_edit.why: Alternating wide and close angles give some change (E2), but shots of 7 to 12 s with plain tips are slow for the message density (R3, R1). Short synced subtitles carry the speech for muted viewers (E4). At 52 s it runs long, with a short, clean fade (R2, E8).

q6_topic.what: Four tips from a speech therapist on reading to a baby of about 5 to 6 months, framed by a mom's admission. Serves a new parent.
q6_topic.why: A practical how-to with an expert, told by a mom who sounds like the viewer, meets a real parenting concern with warmth, not a dry list (K6, K4). Easy to send to a friend with a baby (R5). No gift or occasion, so no buying moment (K7).

q7_filmed.what: Static wide two-shots (0:00, 0:09, 0:46) alternate with handheld close-ups from above of the book, baby and hands. Bright white room, soft daylight, mom and expert on a floor sofa. Nobody looks at the lens.
q7_filmed.why: A home setting, soft light and steady wide shots look phone-made yet clean (H8, F7). Book-page close-ups make the page and the pointing fingers readable (F4). People talk to each other, not to the viewer (F6).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold subtitles, no box, about 70% down the frame, in 2 to 4 word chunks of about 1 s, synced to the voice: "הקפדתי להקריא" (0:04), "חשוב גם לשלב רגש" (0:16), "שורה אחת או שתיים" (0:28), "ספר טוב הוא הרבה" (0:40), "ועוזר לשפה להתפתח" (0:46). Pink smiley at 0:17. No headline, no title, no CTA text.
q8_text.caption: "תודה להלה שלי". Five short lines: thanks to the speech therapist, "על הדגשים החשובים", "זמינות פה לכל שאלה", her tag, four topic hashtags. No question, no book word, no disclosure line.
q8_text.why: Subtitles cover every line, so it works muted (T1), but they run as a near-full transcript for 50 s (T2) in the bottom 35% (T4, F2), grey on white at 0:33 and 0:41 (T5). The caption has specific hashtags but no hook line or product word (T7).

weak_points: No headline or CTA; two long single-angle stretches; near-verbatim subtitles in the bottom band, grey on white at 0:33 and 0:41; the last subtitle stops mid-sentence; unnamed book; the baby's face shown.
lumebook_takeaway: Prop the phone for one wide shot, then close-ups of a hand pointing at the page, one tip per shot, short subtitles, one honest first-person line first.
not_verified: Who speaks each line (mom, expert, voiceover) and whether the audio was recorded live; the book's title and brand; the baby's age (from the transcript only); music; whether the collaboration was paid (no label, no disclosure words). Corrections to the first pass: first subtitle appears at 0:01, not in the first frame; the last subtitle at 0:48 ("וזה בדיוק מה ש" plus the child's name) is gone by 0:49 while the transcript continues to 0:50; burned-in subtitles say "נאריך" where the transcript says "נעריך".
